# PERF-06-B1 genuine pre-B1 legacy fixture (`perf06_b1_columns_v1`)

This package is a **complete CURRENT-reachable index** produced by the frozen
pre-B1 producer compiled against the pinned pre-B1 source. It is the historical
compatibility gate for PERF-06-B1 (COLUMNS v1 → COLUMNS v2 with persistent
keyword ordinals). It is **not** generated by the B1 implementation and must not
be regenerated to make a test pass.

## Package contents

Exactly the six CURRENT-reachable index objects plus `objects.tsv`, `producer.rs`
and this `README.md`. No writer lock, stale manifest, target directory or
generated binary is committed.

The index uses the frozen baseline schema: `body` (Text/Single,
`indexed_stored()`, `standard_folded`), `category` and `city` (Keyword/Single,
indexed+stored+columnar, `keyword` normalizer), `n` (I64/Single, stored+columnar),
`stored_tag` (Keyword/Single, stored only) and `tags` (Keyword/Multi,
indexed+stored+columnar, `keyword` normalizer). Three commits of six documents
each produce generation 3 with 18 documents in 3 segments, and every segment
carries a genuine `COLUMNS` v1 body with no required feature `0x0010`.

## Reproduction rules

Read `objects.tsv` as `# sha256<TAB>bytes<TAB>relative_path`. Never select a
"latest" manifest by directory listing; the inventory is the authoritative
closure. See `docs/pr-artifacts/perf-06-b/PERF06B1_EXECUTION_REPORT.md` for the
observed command/log ledger.
